mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to higher borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 50% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures signals a weakening demand environment, which leads to lower corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where RSAFS shows a sustained decline.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strengthening supply environment, which leads to higher corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances where INDPRO > 1% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment and falling payroll employment signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged in > 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising housing starts and increasing real personal consumption expenditures signals a strengthening demand environment, which leads to higher corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances where HOUST > 1.2M and RSAFS > 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index signals a disinflationary environment, which leads to lower input costs for corporations and higher real earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL declines > 0.5% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of increasing industrial production and rising GDP signals a strengthening supply and demand environment, which leads to higher corporate revenues and earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged in > 50% of instances where INDPRO > 2% YoY and GDPC1 > 2% YoY.
